name: Sentara Leigh Hospital Junior Volunteer Program

offerings.cycle_label: Year-round applications with a structured summer programme - verified 2026-09-08
offerings.summary: Teens who are fourteen by 1 June, have finished eighth grade and hold a C average may apply at any time; the hospital runs a structured summer junior volunteer programme.

age.raw: Junior Volunteers must be at least 14 years old on or before June 1

grades.raw: complete the 8th grade by the end of June, with a 'C' or better average

app.instructions: Apply through the hospital's online Volgistics form, then interview, complete health requirements and attend orientation. Ring the Volunteer Office on 757-261-8085 for dates and hours.

issues: The page names a structured summer programme but publishes no dates or hours.

sources.title: Junior Volunteer Program | Sentara Leigh Hospital

evidence.cycle: Year-round applications with a structured summer programme - verified 2026-09-08
evidence.quote: Junior Volunteers must be at least 14 years old on or before June 1 and complete the 8th grade by the end of June, with a 'C' or better average.
